title: Reasoning from Traces: Divergence-Guided Agentic Repair of WebAssembly Discrepancies
title_zh: 从执行轨迹推理：基于分歧引导的 WebAssembly 差异智能体修复
abstract_en: WebAssembly (Wasm) promises seamless reuse of C/C++ codebases as portable, fast, sandboxed binaries. In practice, however, this promise often falls short: recent studies show that cross-compiling the same C/C++ source to Wasm and native binaries frequently leads to runtime discrepancies, owing to library implementation differences or compiler bugs. Since the root causes lie in the platform-level runtime and are hidden beneath the source code, even state-of-the-art LLM-based repair agents often fail to fix these discrepancies. In this paper, we present WasmMend, the first system to automatically repair Native-Wasm functional discrepancies. WasmMend converts the undirected exploration to a focused reasoning task in two stages: First, a novel differential trace analysis approach localizes the function where Wasm and native executions initially diverge; guided by this localization, LLM agents then reason about the root causes and generate patches that eliminate the divergent behavior. Experiments on real-world C/C++ projects show that WasmMend achieves a fix rate of 70.0%, compared to 50.2% for the agentic baseline and 54.5\% for the approach augmented with repair-time LLM-based instrumentation, demonstrating the value of divergence-guided reasoning for cross-platform repair.
abstract_zh: WebAssembly（Wasm）旨在将 C/C++ 代码库以可移植、高性能、沙箱化二进制形式无缝复用。但实践中，同一 C/C++ 源码交叉编译为 Wasm 与 native 二进制后，常因库实现差异或编译器 bug 出现运行时功能不一致。由于根因隐藏在平台级运行时之下，仅从源代码出发的现有 LLM 修复智能体往往难以定位和修复。本文提出 WasmMend，这是首个自动修复 Native-Wasm 功能差异的系统。WasmMend 将无方向探索转化为聚焦推理任务：首先通过新的差分执行轨迹分析定位 Wasm 与 native 执行首次发生分歧的函数；随后由 LLM agents 基于该定位推理根因并生成补丁，以消除分歧行为。在真实 C/C++ 项目上的实验表明，WasmMend 达到 70.0% 的修复率，高于 agentic baseline 的 50.2% 和加入修复期 LLM instrumentation 的 54.5%，证明了分歧引导推理在跨平台修复中的价值。
key_points_zh: 问题聚焦于同一 C/C++ 程序在 native 与 WebAssembly 编译运行后产生的功能差异，根因通常来自运行时库差异或编译器 bug，而非显式源代码错误。
提出 WasmMend，首个面向 Native-Wasm functional discrepancies 的自动修复系统，将修复过程从盲目搜索转为基于执行分歧的定向推理。
核心技术是 differential trace analysis：比较 native 与 Wasm 执行轨迹，定位两者首次发生行为分歧的函数，为后续 LLM agents 提供高价值上下文。
LLM agents 在定位结果引导下分析平台级根因并生成补丁，从而修复由跨平台语义差异导致的错误行为。
在真实 C/C++ 项目实验中，WasmMend 修复率为 70.0%，显著优于 agentic baseline 的 50.2% 和带 LLM instrumentation 的 54.5%。

llm_assessment.comment: A relevant coding-agent repair system that uses differential traces to focus agent reasoning for cross-platform fixes.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项相关的代码智能体修复系统，利用差分轨迹引导智能体进行跨平台缺陷修复。
